finding: A suspended camera appContext load outlives window A. After release a new request in B could start a second load and either continuation could overwrite the other's presentation.
resolution: Keep one observed cameraContextLoading claim across window release. Do not consume a newer request while loading. Existing presentation transfers to an active window. Completion changes are observed by the scene to drain a pending request after success or failure.
productionBoundary: Default consume and context callbacks still call the original HanlinCameraCaptureRequests and CameraCaptureIntent.appContext. Test controls only their asynchronous delivery; it invokes the actual coordinator and creates real owned directories.

validation.nativeTestExecution: NOT_RUN; integrated root queue owns it
